The Hessian's Shares From a Filtered Block's Own Movement

Source: R/jfp_engine.R
jfp_filter_hessian.Rd

Computes the terms of \(\partial_{kl}\log|\tilde I|\) that the movement of the block's rows contributes, for a block inside the subformula of a filter's parameter, whose rows are derivatives of the filtered predictors.

Usage

jfp_filter_hessian(st, bs, dE)

Arguments

st

A state, from jfp_state().

bs

A block's entry of the state, of kind "filter".

dE

The derivative of the expected information, from jfp_dexpected().

Value

A list with H, a matrix over the joint vector, and BV, the rows to add to the low-rank factor, in the convention of jfp_hessian().

Details

With the whitened directions \(d_i = C U^{-1}e_i\) the block's rows are \(Z_{q,t,i} = \partial\eta_{q,t}[d_i]\), \(C\tilde I^{-1}C^\top = \sum_i d_id_i^\top\), and the derivative of the rows in \(u_k\) is \(R^{(i)}_{q,t,k} = \partial^2\eta_{q,t}[d_i, k]\). Then \(\mathrm{tr}(\tilde I^{-1}\partial_{kl}\tilde I)\) gains $$2\sum_t w_t\sum_{q,r}\sum_i\Big[\sum_c\partial_c\mathcal I_{qr} \big(V_{c,t,k}Z_{q,t,i}R^{(i)}_{r,t,l} + (k\leftrightarrow l)\big) + \mathcal I_{qr}Z_{q,t,i}\,\partial^3\eta_{r,t}[d_i,k,l] + \mathcal I_{qr}R^{(i)}_{q,t,k}R^{(i)}_{r,t,l}\Big],$$ and the whitened derivative \(U^{-\top}\partial_k\tilde I U^{-1}\) gains \(X^{(a)}_{kb} + X^{(b)}_{ka}\) with \(X^{(a)}_{kb} = \sum_t w_t \sum_{q,r}\mathcal I_{qr}R^{(a)}_{q,t,k}Z_{r,t,b}\). One call of modelterms7::term_third() per direction gives both \(\partial^3\eta[d_i,\cdot,\cdot]\) and \(R^{(i)}\), so the second derivatives of the rows are never held for more than one direction.
